items.headline: Maersk, Hapag-Lloyd add four Suez services
items.summary: Maersk confirmed four more Gemini Cooperation container services (AE5, AE11, AE12, ME2) will shift back to the Suez Canal from the Cape route starting September 19, citing improved Red Sea security.

items.headline: ACER closes consultation on REMIT-EMIR overlap annex
items.summary: ACER's public consultation on a new annex clarifying reporting boundaries between REMIT and EMIR for energy derivatives ran through 11 September, aiming to reduce dual-reporting ambiguity for market participants.

items.headline: UK EMIR Phase II reconciliation deadline arrives
items.summary: UK EMIR Refit Phase II trade-repository reconciliation begins September 28, adding roughly 61 fields including valuation updates, following the EU's equivalent phase in April.

items.headline: ITFA dissects trade finance lessons from First Brands
items.summary: Commodity Trading Week hosted ITFA advisory board members to examine governance and transparency failures exposed by the First Brands collapse, and their implications for supply-chain and receivables financing controls.
